name: Fusion Sportswear
note: Danish apparel maker (FUSION ApS, Svenstrup J); official apparel sponsor and kit maker of Uno-X Mobility since 2025 (fusionworld.com Uno-X page). Ownership: company-register aggregator ownr.dk (CVR 26685869) lists Fusion Sport Holding ApS as 100% legal owner and six members of the Nissen family as ultimate owners; no primary or named-press source found to confirm, so left unrated (not rated yet).
